snippet.title: Loyalty Isn’t Always About Blood 👇
snippet.description:
Loyalty Isn’t Always About Blood 👇

A man fiercely defends the woman he loves.

He declares his devotion isn’t to the family he was born into—

But to the person who holds his heart.

Tensions rise as accusations fly about betrayal, suffering, and public disgrace.

A mother steps in bluntly, demanding they face the truth.

She calls out a toxic cycle of selfishness and childishness—

Insisting that their personal pain is no excuse to hurt everyone around them.

In their world, appearances and duty clash with personal desires.

Loyalty here is complicated, not about tradition but about where true allegiance lies.

👉 Love can redefine family ties in unexpected ways.

👉 Avoid blaming others for consequences of personal choices.

👉 Responsibility means making difficult decisions with integrity, not convenience.

The uncomfortable truth?

Sometimes, loyalty means choosing love over blood, even when it challenges everything expected.

And power carries a heavy price—not just privilege, but the burden of living up to what people need you to be.

So the real question is:

When is it time to put personal happiness above reputation and obligation? 👇💬

"The first time I ever really listened to Kyle Kulinski’s show was in the back of a cab last summer. The driver had his phone hooked up through the stereo and was pumping out an episode through the car speakers — loudly, as if looking to convert a captive audience.

“Do you like Kyle Kulinski?”

The driver, Ahmed, was a recent immigrant and apparently a die-hard fan of Secular Talk, the political talk show that Kulinski broadcasts on YouTube. I told him, yes, in fact. I do like Kulinski, had come across his show several years ago, and, all things considered, he seemed pretty good.

“He understands what we’re up against,” Ahmed said. “Like Bernie.”

But I was surprised to hear Kulinski’s name mentioned in the same breath as Bernie Sanders, particularly with such adoration. Because what I did remember about Kulinski’s show struck me as mostly capital-P “progressive” takes on the news — the left wing of the Netroots crowd more than the democratic socialism Sanders has popularized.

It’s an impression that wasn’t entirely incorrect.

“I have no time for philosophical, airy bullshit,” Kulinski tells me from his home in Westchester, New York. “I don’t want to hear about Lenin. I don’t want to hear about Marx. I just want a super plainspoken, straightforward agenda with a straightforward way of selling it.”

With over 800,000 subscribers and nearly 670 million total views on YouTube, selling a progressive agenda is clearly something Kulinski knows how to do — even Democracy Now, the long-standing flagship of progressive media, cannot match his reach on the platform. Chapo Trap House can certainly boast a wildly devoted fan base (and a not insignificant degree of media influence), but their audience is roughly half the size of Kulinski’s.

While Secular Talk might be more likely to be looped in with the progressive networks around Air America and Pacifica alums like Sam Seder than the more resolutely socialist world, Kulinski’s fiery rhetoric, razor-sharp class instincts, and knack for withering takedowns sets him apart from his peers. Judging by his rhetoric alone, he’s closer to a Eugene Debs than a Chris Hayes.

But unlike Hayes, Amy Goodman, or his friend Cenk Uygur of The Young Turks — who began airing Secular Talk on his web network seven years ago — the thirty-two-year-old Kulinski is virtually invisible in the mainstream media. Despite his enormous fan base, his show has never once been mentioned in the obligatory trend pieces on “the Millennial Left” pumped out by the prestige media. Nor has Kulinski’s name ever popped up at all in the New York Times, Vox, the New Yorker, New York Magazine, or the Washington Post, despite his leading role in cofounding Justice Democrats, the organization widely credited with sweeping Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and the rest of “the Squad” to power.

Just last week, his Wikipedia page was deleted. The reason? “There is very simply no [reliable source] coverage of this person,” according to one moderator. In new media, he’s king — the Sean Hannity of the Berniecrat left. In old media, he’s nobody.

I suspect there are a few reasons for that. There is nothing “cool” about Kulinski’s show. (As a friend put it, “‘Welcome to Secular Talk’ sounds like something you’d hear on Egyptian radio.”) His no-nonsense social-democratic politics won’t get him much cred with the Full Communism crowd. He records his show not in Brooklyn or Los Angeles, but in a studio he built himself in his modest Westchester home. His hair is too groomed and his taste in clothes too preppy to qualify as “Dirtbag Left.” Nor has he ever attended an n+1 release party. “Not only have I not attended one,” he says, “I have no idea what that means.”

And yet he’s astonishingly plugged-in for a young man in the suburbs. Wondering how Sanders ended up on the Joe Rogan Experience? Kulinski, a frequent guest on Rogan’s wildly popular show, introduced them. “You make the most sense to me,” Rogan told Kulinski on a recent episode. “You’re a normal person.”

Much like Sanders himself, Kulinski’s show has a massive audience that just doesn’t compute with our media’s understanding of “what the kids want” or even “what the left-wing kids want.”

It’s probably for the best — the very woke and very WASP-ish decorum haunting much of the media world is nowhere to be found in Secular Talk. “Corporate Democrats over-focus on identity as a trick to divert you from the issues that unite us all — class issues,” he said on a recent episode.

snippet.title: Por que o titã não quebra as pernas? 🦴 #attackontitan #shingekinokyojin #anime #shorts
snippet.description:
Um titã de 15 metros é você nove vezes maior. Só que ele cresce na altura, na largura e na grossura: o peso fica 729 vezes maior, uns 51 mil quilos. O osso só engrossa nos dois lados do corte, então fica só 81 vezes mais forte. Cada pedaço de osso carrega nove vezes mais que o seu.
O Galileu já tinha percebido isso em 1638: um gigante quebraria com o próprio peso.
O Robert Wadlow, o homem mais alto já medido (2,72 m), só andava com aparelhos de ferro nas pernas. Em 1940, um aparelho feriu o tornozelo dele, a ferida infeccionou e ele morreu aos 22 anos. E ele nem tinha o dobro da sua altura.
O Colossal tem 60 metros. Pela mesma conta, o osso dele quebraria com ele parado.
Mas a Hange chutou a cabeça de um titã e descobriu o segredo.

snippet.title: Can You Lose a Lawsuit You Didn't Know Existed?
snippet.description:
This nightclub lost a lawsuit it didn't even know had been filed, all because of three men named Jesse Gurley 📬

In 2015, a woman sued an Illinois LLC after slipping on a substance on the floor of one of its nightclubs in East St. Louis. Every LLC has to list a registered agent, the person who officially receives lawsuits for the company. This one listed "Jesse Gurley" with no suffix, at the Gurley family home.

The company meant Jesse Gurley IV, but he had moved out in 2012. His dad, Jesse Gurley III, and his son, Jesse Gurley V, still lived there, and neither had anything to do with the LLC. When the process server asked for Jesse Gurley, Jesse Gurley III accepted the papers. He never passed them on, nobody answered the lawsuit, and the court entered a default judgment of $42,837.

The company appealed, arguing it was never properly served because the papers went to the wrong Jesse. The appellate court disagreed, ruling that the company had absolute control over identifying and locating its registered agent, and the process server simply followed the company's own directions.

The lesson is that whatever's on your state filing is on you. Your registered agent should be a professional at a reliable address who doesn't share a name or an address with your father or your son.

Look up your own LLC on your Secretary of State's website today.

snippet.description:
หญิงปริศนาปรากฏตัว ! อ้างเป็นคนซื้อเว็บพนันออนไลน์จาก “กัน จอมพลัง” และสังคมก็ยังรอคำตอบ ปมเงินบริจาคมูลนิธิกันจอมพลังช่วยสู้

ช็อตเด็ด นาทีเดือด !

00:00 อึ้ง ! พยานปากเอก บุกประจันหน้า แฉ “ซื้อเว็บ” จาก “กันจอมพลัง” !  
07:38 พยานปากนี้เชื่อถือได้แค่ไหน? ผู้เชี่ยวชาญชำแหละน้ำหนักและความน่าเชื่อถือของคำกล่าวอ้าง 
14:28 ปมโอนเงินคืน “หนุ่ม กรรชัย” 1 ล้าน เปิดประเด็นการคืนเงินก้อนโตกลางดราม่าร้อน 
15:20 เจาะลึกเส้นเงินบริจาค ตรงวัตถุประสงค์หรือไม่? ตั้งคำถามความโปร่งใสในการบริหารจัดการเงิน 
19:11 จับพิรุธการ “สโคปประเด็น” ตอบคำถาม ทำไมถึงเลือกตอบเฉพาะบางเรื่อง? 
27:11 โอนคืน 1 ล้าน จบคดีได้จริงหรือ? วิเคราะห์แง่มุมทางกฎหมาย การคืนเงินช่วยล้างความผิดได้ไหม? 
51:23 DSI จ่อลุยเช็กเส้นเงิน

วันที่ 26 พ.ย. 69 พล.ต.ต. วิชัย สังข์ประไพ อดีตรองผู้บัญชาการตำรวจนครบาล ออกมาเล่าเรื่องราวผ่านรายการ “ถกไม่เถียง” ทางช่อง one31 ดำเนินรายการโดย ทิน โชคกมลกิจ ว่า จากที่มีหญิงปริศนาออกมาเปิดเผยว่าได้ซื้อเว็บพนันออนไลน์จาก กัน จอมพลัง การซื้อขายนี้อาจจะไม่ได้ใช้วิธีการโอนเงินแบบปกติ เรื่องนี้ถือว่าค่อนข้างมีน้ำหนัก เพราะคนที่เปิดเผยก็จะมีความเสี่ยงทำผิดกฎหมายไปด้วย

ทนายเกิดผล แก้วเกิด ทนายความ ให้ความเห็นว่า ความน่าเชื่อถือเรื่องมีคนซื้อเว็บพนันจาก กัน จอมพลัง ไม่สามารถปักใจเชื่อได้ 100 เปอร์เซ็นต์ เพราะหลายคดีก็มีพยานเท็จที่สุดท้ายแล้วพยานเท็จเหล่านี้มักไปจนมุมในศาล ซึ่งสุดท้ายแล้วจะต้องดูพยานหลักฐานทั้งหมดว่าเป็นไปตามที่ถูกกล่าวหาหรือไม่

การเลี่ยงไม่ตอบคำถามบางประเด็นของ กัน จอมพลัง โดยเฉพาะปมเงินบริจาค แม้ว่าจะเป็นสิทธิ์ของเจ้าตัวแต่ทำให้สังคมเกิดข้อสงสัยว่า ถ้าบริสุทธิ์ใจจริงทำไมถึงไม่กล้าตอบทุกคำถาม หรืออาจเป็นเพราะกลัวพูดแล้วไม่ตรงกับสำนวนคดีของตำรวจ และปกติแล้วคนแบบ กัน จอมพลัง มักจะมีท่าทีดุดันเตรียมทุกหลักฐานมาชี้แจงเสมอ

snippet.title: Tricolour Modelling Clay Manufacturing 🇮🇳 | How Colourful Clay Is Made in Factory
snippet.description:
Ever wondered how professional modelling clay is produced? Step inside an Indian manufacturing facility to witness the mesmerizing transformation of raw ingredients into vibrant, perfectly shaped tricolour clay blocks.

This video provides an up-close look at the industrial process, from the initial mixing of pigments and base materials to the precision of automated extrusion and cutting. See the dedicated craftsmanship as workers knead the material to achieve the perfect consistency before the final blocks are carefully inspected, packaged, and sealed for distribution. The combination of heavy machinery and human attention to detail ensures that every set meets high standards of quality and uniformity.

From the rhythmic churning of industrial mixers to the crisp mechanical movements of the conveyor belt, follow the entire journey of this creative tool from the factory floor to the final box. This look behind the curtain reveals the scale and efficiency required to bring these colourful art supplies to life, highlighting the fascinating synergy between technology and skilled manual labor in modern manufacturing environments.
